messages:
emma: Morning team  final dry-run for marketplace launch tomorrow. Quick checklist: partner preview links seeded? hardware demo rack reserved? SI smoke schedule? embargo/press timing confirmed? landing CTA locked? utm/campaign tags in analytics sheet?

rafael: Partner preview: generated secure preview links for partners (acme, nova, edgecloud) and shared via secure share at T-45m. Links expire T+2h. Asked partners to validate logos and pricing tiles.

priya: Hardware demo: EdgeCloud asked for 4U in rack C2 for the partner demo. Logistics confirmed power and network tagging. I'll add contact and rack photo to the runbook.

ben: SI smoke: scheduled connector smoke at 11:00 PT. Noted an intermittent 502 on multipart uploads; increased client retry window in staging. Pasted minimal curl snippet in SI onboarding: 

```
# chunked upload example
curl -X POST "https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/upload?chunk=1/4" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --data-binary @piece-1.bin
```

Also asked partners to paste logs into this thread.

emma: Embargo plan? press time?

press-bot: Embargo lift scheduled 08:30 PT. Partners receive kit at T-30m. Targeted press mailout at T. Press kit includes approved quotes and hero screenshots (PNG + SVG). Reminder: no quote edits after lift.

rafael: Landing page: CTA variants A/B still on. Product prefers A: "Try Redwood Inference in Marketplace" for parity with partner listings. Marketing asked to freeze copy by 07:00 PT. UTMs added to tracking doc: utm_source=partner_marketplace, utm_campaign=launch_spring.

priya: CDN: cdn-bot, will invalidation run after publish? any staging cache concerns?

cdn-bot: CDN invalidation queued at T+90s after publish. Note: edge cache TTLs: 300s default, but hero images use `cache-control: max-age=60` until T+10m. If any last-minute image swap, add ?v=timestamp as cache-bust.

ben: Rollback / health gates: ops agreed on health gate: listing success >= 99% and median page load <750ms sustained for 5m. Auto-fallback to hosted-tiles variant if errors exceed threshold. Provisioning state will not be auto-rolled back; manual DB action required for provisioning reversion.

emma: Legal: any outstanding trademark lines or quote approvals?

rafael: Legal cleared quotes in press kit except one partner co-brand line; legal will confirm by 06:30 PT. If not cleared, we'll remove partner co-brand quote from release and note in partner share.

priya: Final thumbs at 06:45 PT. Post single word: yes/no/blocker. If blocker, include 1-line reason and @emma.

ben: yes

rafael: yes

emma: yes :thumbsup:

priya: Thanks  will monitor partner smoke at 11:00 PT and post results here. If anyone sees a blocker after smoke, escalate to #support and tag me.
